raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Bumps [spmd-types](https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types) from 0.2.3 to 0.3.1.
Release notes

Sourced from spmd-types's releases.

v0.3.1

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1

v0.3.0

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.2.5...v0.3.0

v0.2.5

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.2.4...v0.2.5

v0.2.4

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4

Commits
  • 7deaf24 Reject DTensor _NormPartial in global-mode shard propagation
  • 1a9d01d Fix global-mode collectives on size-1 or untyped axes
  • 6d3e40f Fix all_gather(V->I) backward for nonzero gather_dim
  • fce1acb Add async_op to defer functional-collective waits
  • a1b86de Skip type checking for Tensor._is_view
  • 2ae49fc Use eager clone instead of CoW in replicate_to_varying
  • 8b8a56e Normalize override keys in assert_type_like and assert_local_type_like
  • aac9da2 Skip type checking for tensor metadata queries such as stride()
  • c053ae3 Fix llama4x-static-type-check: assert_type overload variance
  • 320a775 Move internal agent guidance to fb/CLAUDE.md; forbid Buck
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
